limitation: Saved-data binding, input preparation, feature and parser scalar audit; no independent CGR forward or rotation-matrix recomputation
audit_program:
"""Read-only NumPy audit of the saved CGR; no model or simulator imports."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path('/home/wangrenpeng/AnyDexGrasp')
BASE = ROOT/'outputs/boya_author_scene_20261114_v4'
REP = BASE/'representation/representations/development_three_20261114'
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda path: json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
ash = lambda value: hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(value).tobytes()).hexdigest()
r = read(REP/'RESULTS.json'); obs = read(BASE/'capture/observation.json')
assert r['status'] == 'representation_forward_complete'
assert sha(BASE/'representation_manifest.json') == r['manifest_sha256']
assert sha(BASE/'capture/observation.json') == r['scene_binding']['observation_sha256']
assert not r['scene_binding']['object_pose_as_network_input']
assert r['scene_binding']['T_WC'] == obs['T_WC']
bindings = {}
for path,digest in r['source_sha256'].items(): bindings[path] = digest
for path,value in r['input_files'].items(): bindings[path] = value['sha256']
for value in r['output_files'].values(): bindings[value['path']] = value['sha256']
bindings[r['checkpoint']['path']] = r['checkpoint']['sha256']
for path,digest in bindings.items(): assert sha(path) == digest, path
depth = np.asarray(Image.open(BASE/'capture/depth.png'))
K = np.asarray(obs['intrinsic_matrix']); z = depth/obs['depth_factor']
u,v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(depth.shape[1]), np.arange(depth.shape[0]))
mask = (z > r['args']['depth_min'])&(z < r['args']['depth_max'])
points = np.stack([(u-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*z, (v-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*z, z], axis=-1)[mask].astype(np.float32)
coords = np.ascontiguousarray(points/r['args']['voxel_size'], dtype=int)
assert ash(points) == r['input_points_sha256']
assert ash(coords) == r['input_coords_sha256']
with np.load(REP/'representation_outputs.npz',allow_pickle=False) as saved:
    a = {k:saved[k] for k in saved.files}
with np.load(REP/'raw_camera_candidates.npz',allow_pickle=False) as saved:
    c,f = saved['candidates'],saved['candidate_features']
assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for value in [*a.values(), c, f])
assert np.array_equal(a['raw_CGR_480'], a['stage3_grasp_features'][...,:480])
for name in r['output_shapes']: assert list(a[name].shape) == r['output_shapes'][name]
unique,first = np.unique(coords,axis=0,return_index=True)
stored = a['sparse_input_coords'][:,1:]
order = np.lexsort(stored.T[::-1]); assert np.array_equal(stored[order], unique)
assert np.array_equal(a['sparse_input_XYZ_features'][order],points[first])
assert np.array_equal(a['sparse_input_coords'][:,0],np.zeros(len(stored),dtype=np.int32))
s = a['stage3_grasp_scores'][0]; pair = np.minimum(s[:,:24],s[:,24:])
angle_by_depth = pair.argmax(axis=1); best_by_depth = pair.max(axis=1)
depth_class = best_by_depth.argmax(axis=1); index = np.arange(len(c))
angle_class = angle_by_depth[index,depth_class]
score = best_by_depth[index,depth_class]
widths = np.minimum(a['stage3_normalized_grasp_widths'][0]*np.float32(.099),np.float32(.099))
width = widths[index,angle_class,depth_class]+widths[index,angle_class+24,depth_class]
depths = (depth_class.astype(np.float32)+1)*np.float32(.01)-np.float32(.01)
depths[depth_class==0] = np.float32(.005)
assert np.array_equal(c[:,0],score)
assert np.array_equal(c[:,1],width)
assert np.array_equal(c[:,2],depths)
assert np.array_equal(c[:,-3:],a['stage2_seed_xyz'][0])
segments = [s.reshape(len(c),-1), a['stage3_grasp_features'][0],
            a['before_generator'][0], a['point_features'][0],
            a['stage2_view_inds'][0,:,None], a['stage2_view_scores'][0,:,None],
            a['stage2_seed_inds'][0,:,None]]
offset=0
for segment in segments:
    end=offset+segment.shape[1]
    assert np.array_equal(f[:,offset:end],segment.astype(np.float32)); offset=end
assert np.array_equal(f[:,-1],depths)
assert np.allclose(f[:,-2],angle_class,atol=2e-6,rtol=0)
result = dict(schema='anydex_author_scene_independent_CGR_binding_v1',status='complete',
    manifest_sha256=r['manifest_sha256'],observation_sha256=sha(BASE/'capture/observation.json'),
    source_input_checkpoint_and_output_sha256=bindings,
    retained_camera_xyz=len(points),input_xyz_sha256=r['input_points_sha256'],
    input_integer_coords_sha256=r['input_coords_sha256'],sparse_voxels=len(unique),
    sparse_xyz_first_pixel_features_exact=True,full_features_prefix_exact=True,
    candidate_count=len(c),candidate_scores_widths_depths_centres_exact=True,
    all_saved_arrays_finite=True,raw_CGR480_exact=True,object_pose_as_network_input=False,
    original_forward_count_from_receipt=1,new_model_loads=0,new_CGR_forwards=0,
    new_physics_steps=0,new_training_updates=0,
    limitation='Saved-data binding, input preparation, feature and parser scalar audit; no independent CGR forward or rotation-matrix recomputation',
    audit_program=Path(__file__).read_text(),audit_program_sha256=sha(__file__))
out=ROOT/'reproduction/boya/evidence/author_scene_20261114/CGR_BINDING_AUDIT.json'
if out.exists(): raise FileExistsError(out)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['source_input_checkpoint_and_output_sha256','audit_program']})
